selected_evidence.requirement: C.UTF-8 is the default for new login sessions and services
selected_evidence.summary: The persisted locale is LANG=C.UTF-8; fresh service and login contexts report LANG=C.UTF-8 and CHARMAP=UTF-8 before and after restart.

Healthy baseline boot ID ce162994-f0d3-4b45-a974-becf96a3e59e was captured, the safe reboot was acknowledged, boot ID changed to afd1cfb4-e7b4-4de6-9267-fe19bf66b254, and node1 returned to running state with the locale configuration and fresh-context behavior intact.
